events.title: Microsoft’s CFO admits she joined the tech giant without even knowing her salary—and then missed her first day of work

events.title: Microsoft CFO Amy Hood discusses career uncertainty in Duke speech: Trial Balance
events.body: Addressing roughly 7,000 Duke graduates during a commencement speech on Sunday, Hood shared lessons that align with many of the challenges facing her CFO peers.
